nodes.name: Patient-20
nodes.summary: Patient-20, born October 1, 1953 (case ID URO-2026-0020), had advanced C61 Prostatakarzinom with a Gleason score of 4+5=9 (ISUP 5), a BRCA2 mutation, and cT4 cN1 cM1c staging. On December 8, 2028, total PSA was 40.0 ng/ml. On December 29, 2028, total PSA was 48.4 ng/ml, and second-line therapy with Cabazitaxel 25 mg/m² q3w continued. On January 19, 2029, total PSA rose to 58.6 ng/ml. On January 20, 2029, the patient was discharged after inpatient administration of Cabazitaxel. On April 13, 2029, the patient had a palliative care consultation under Dr. med. Arzt-11 with an ECOG status of 4, presenting with knochenschmerzen, fatigue, and gewichtsverlust, with WHO step 3 pain management adjustments and SAPV recommendation. Patient-20 died on May 7, 2029, from progressive metastasiertes kastrationsresistentes Prostatakarzinom.

nodes.name: Prostatakarzinom
nodes.summary: Patient-20 has a diagnosis of advanced C61 Prostatakarzinom (prostate adenocarcinoma) staged as cT4 cN1 cM1c with a Gleason score of 4+5=9 (ISUP 5) and a confirmed pathogenic germline BRCA2 mutation. Symptoms include bone pain (Knochenschmerzen), fatigue, and weight loss (Gewichtsverlust), alongside an ECOG performance status reaching 4. The treatment plan involved androgen deprivation therapy (ADT) combined with a PARP inhibitor, transitioning to second-line chemotherapy with Cabazitaxel (25 mg/m² q3w) following disease progression. Total PSA levels rose from 4.6 ng/ml on January 6, 2028, to 40.0 ng/ml on December 8, 2028, 48.4 ng/ml on December 29, 2028, and 58.6 ng/ml on January 19, 2029, demonstrating ongoing biochemical progression until all curative therapy approaches were exhausted and the patient passed away on May 7, 2029, due to progressive metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer.
